subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds model-facing tool semantics, config defaults, and persisted routing behavior in message-delivery/session-state code where repository policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Review and land the linked PR or an equivalent after resolving merge conflicts, keeping current channel delivery as the default.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Accept only the model-facing per-call option now and defer global/per-agent config defaults until upgrade and operator-policy implications are clearer.

options.title: Keep callback workaround
options.body: Decline the public routing option for now and leave parent handoff to explicit `sessions_send` patterns until a broader orchestration contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR or an equivalent after resolving merge conflicts, keeping current channel delivery as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool area and already wrote the focused implementation shape in the issue discussion.
